# OXR checkpoint metadata fixtures

These are original small files from `SoMarkAI/OXR-1.0` at immutable revision
`c708407f9d2b4df658f2543d9132b62bb7221df4`. The safetensors fixture is the
actual 101,080-byte JSON header, pretty-printed; the 3,068,857,520-byte tensor
payload has not been downloaded or executed. All 752 original tensors retain
their names, shapes, dtypes, and offsets here.

The source identity and full-weight SHA256 are recorded in
`models/oxr-source.json`. These structural fixtures cannot prove conversion,
model loading, OCR quality or latency. The checkpoint's OXR additional-terms
license applies; see the retained license and notice.
